name: Astera
source:
An intelligent girl with a boyish demeanor on the express. She sits in a wheelchair due to her physical disability. She hates to cause trouble for others, and prefers to stay alone.
[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2024/11/30/karudea/]official website[/url]]
